technology_name: AN AUTOMATIC SCRAP CLEANING SYSTEM FOR LATHE AND CLEANING METHOD THEREOF
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Automated Industrial Maintenance / Lathe Telemetry Unit
problem_solved: Manual removal of razor-sharp metal swarf chips from active lathe machine beds causes severe operator laceration hazards and requires turning off machine lines, stalling shop throughput.
description: An automated swarf extraction setup integration comprising an internal industrial machine frame, an array of optical sensors, a wide-angle surveillance camera module, a traveling scraper plow assembly, and an electronic safety control network.
applications: Automated CNC manufacturing cells, heavy industrial machine shops, educational engineering fabrication labs, and autonomous workshop maintenance systems.
